description: Distributed locks for agents: acquire a named lock with a TTL (atomic, one holder at a time), extend, release or check it. Stops two agents from doing the same job, paying the same invoice or editing the same file. Private to your wallet, or shared through a space string. Costs $0.002 USDC per call (x402).

space.description: Optional shared namespace (any secret string): agents using the same space share it. Default: your paying wallet.
